prompt:
Rebuild the build `first-volley` from the art library and the technique catalogue, then fight it on combat engine v2 (run through fight.py).

Read, and nothing else: the guide design/builds/overnight-2026-11-10/builds/first-volley.md; the old fight files design/builds/overnight-2026-11-10/builds/first-volley*.fight.json (Glob them); the build-file format tools/design/combat_sim/FIGHT-INPUT.md; design/arts/INDEX.md (every technique, signature art and common art on one line). For one library art's full mechanic, Grep its id in design/arts/family-*.md.

Rules:
1. Keep the build's concept, realm, root (`purity`), layers, crit, ward, body, keystones, curses and every piece that does not come from an art or a technique: Effects from Đạo, items, the tree or keystones stay as they are.
2. Techniques (`"techniques": [ids]`): one main method (tech_kind main) and up to two auxiliary techniques (secret or body), from the catalogue. Each must be usable by the root: every id it names must be an element the build has purity in (hoa fire, thuy water, tho earth, kim metal, moc wood, bang ice, loi thunder, phong wind); a body technique is always usable. Instead of one catalogue technique you may keep a generated common technique (not listed in `techniques`); it brings exactly one common art.
3. Arts: every art is `{"lib": "<id>"}` with no overrides, and is either carried by a chosen technique at an unlock layer the realm allows (layer <= 3 at luyen_khi, 6 at truc_co, 9 at ket_dan, 12 at nguyen_anh) or the one common art of a generated common technique. Use no more arts than fight.py's slots allow (slots_by_realm + bonus_slots).
4. Remove the old invented arts and any effects, counters or states that belonged only to them. Pick the techniques and arts that best serve the build's concept, preferring a whole suite whose engine the rest of the build feeds. Where an old identity piece was an invented art with no library equivalent, take the closest library art or suite and record the loss.
5. Never tune a number. Never edit the library, the catalogue or the old files.

Write design/builds/engine-v2/builds/first-volley.fight.json for the build's defining realm, and design/builds/engine-v2/builds/first-volley.<realm>.fight.json for each other realm the old build had a fight file for (same choices, the arts the realm unlocks).

Run `python tools/design/combat_sim/fight.py design/builds/engine-v2/builds/first-volley.fight.json --matrix`, then the same with `--without tech:<the main technique id>`, then with `--without <the build's identity piece>` (an art id or an effect id). Run each other realm file once without --matrix.

Write design/builds/engine-v2/first-volley.md: the build's name and concept in one line; a table | Old piece | Library piece | Technique (layer) |; the techniques chosen and why; what was lost in the move; a table | Matchup | Mean s | W-L-other | You dry | Foe dry | Clipped |; the two --without tests (same-realm typical, before and after); the UNMODELLED lines, one each with why; one paragraph of observations: fight length against the 30-60 s band at the same realm, whether the guide's claims still hold, NEVER_FIRED arts.
End your final message with: LIB-DONE design/builds/engine-v2/first-volley.md
